verdict.rationale: The skill can be distributed through a Claude Code plugin marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add` plus install). It can also be copied into a project skills directory, which can be committed to a shared repo. It uses the open Agent Skills folder format, so it is portable across compatible agents, and a packaging script produces uploadable zips. missing for 10: no explicit guidance on team-wide or org-level rollout or version pinning, no independent corroboration of team distribution, and it is a single skill rather than a curated multi-skill set.
